notes: The Liao History passage cites the Liu Song historian Fan Ye as an authorial precedent; his Song History biography identifies the same man as the compiler of the History of the Later Han.
Fan Ye 范曄, the Liu Song historian (c. 398-445), is distinct from the Eastern Han administrator Fan Ye 樊晔, active AD 25-57.

The Jurchen royal relatives Alihemian 阿離合懣, attested under Jingzu (1021-1074), and Zhuan 瑑, also called Alicheman 阿離合懣 but attested under Shizong (1161-1189), cannot be the same person despite sharing a transcribed name.
The historian's childhood name Zhuan 磚 and the Jurchen royal relative's name Zhuan 瑑 are different Chinese names borne centuries apart.
